mapper.select: SELECT id, email, phone, password_hash, role, avatar_path, status, created_at FROM public.user_account WHERE (#{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND email = #{email}) OR (#{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND phone = #{phone})
INSERT INTO public.user_account (email, phone, password_hash) VALUES (#{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}) RETURNING id, email, phone, password_hash, role, avatar_path, status, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_session (token_hash, user_id, created_at, expires_at) SELECT #{tokenHash}, id, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt} FROM public.user_account WHERE id = #{userId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.email, a.phone, a.password_hash, a.role, a.avatar_path, a.status, a.created_at FROM public.auth_session s JOIN public.user_account a ON a.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND a.status = 1
